label: Something maximal in being causes all being, from the cause of the idea of INFINITE_3
description: Bridge from the idea-of-the-infinite argument to the quarta via's conclusion STMT-MAXIME-ENS-CAUSES-BEING-OF-ALL, over one grades frame. The cause c of the meditator's idea of the infinite is in act in the infinite (INFINITE_3). The open bridge 'whatever is in act in the infinite is maximal in being' makes c maximal in being (MAXIME_ENS_1), and the genus principle at being (da09703b) makes c the cause of the being of every other being that has being. So something maximal in being causes being in every other being. This replaces the quarta via's grades, approach-to-a-maximum and truth-to-being premises by the idea-of-the-infinite premises and one open naming bridge. Only the infinite-to-maximality bridge connects the two families; it is not a definitional equality. The objective-reality cause relation (ObjCause) occurs only in the first premise and is not passed into the cause-of-being relation (CAUSE_2). Every premise stays open.
